summary: Iteration 2 testing of OCR engine settings (gemini|olmocr|auto + fallback), per-upload engine_override, AI Co-Pilot chat, and tenant isolation. Backend: 15/15 new tests + 26/26 regression tests pass (41/41 = 100%). Frontend: Settings page (all data-testids, save+test connection, auto engine selection), non-admin /settings forbidden screen, Layout sidebar nav-settings visibility, DocumentViewer Copilot panel (open/starters/send/receive Gemini reply/close), engine-badge, engine-attempts panel, reprocess-engine-select, Documents list 'via {engine}' badge, and Documents list integration all work. CRITICAL bug found and fixed in DocumentUpload.jsx — the page crashed with 'engineOverride is not defined' (ReferenceError) because the useState was missing. After adding `const [engineOverride, setEngineOverride] = useState('')`, the upload-engine-select dropdown renders correctly with options ['', 'gemini', 'olmocr', 'auto'].

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime ReferenceError: 'engineOverride is not defined' — missing useState declaration broke the entire /upload page after file selection. FIXED by testing agent (added const [engineOverride, setEngineOverride] = useState('') at line 13).

issues: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings persist from iter1 (not blocking).

action_items: Validate the DocumentUpload.jsx fix (already applied by testing agent). Confirm no other components reference engineOverride incorrectly.
(LOW) Add input validation on Settings — olmocr_timeout currently allows non-numeric strings via HTML <input type='number'>; backend Pydantic int coercion will catch but a frontend hint would help.
(LOW) Consider showing the test-connection result text inline beneath the button (it renders but is small).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1138 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into auth.py, documents.py, ocr_engines.py, copilot.py, exports.py modules.
API key masking is well-implemented: GET returns ***LAST4, PUT ignores any value beginning with *** so the real key isn't overwritten. Good security pattern.

Cross-tenant isolation verified: copilot/chat endpoint scopes db.documents.find_one by tenant_id, returning 404 for cross-tenant doc access. /tenants/me/ocr-settings is intrinsically per-tenant via /me.
extract_with_engine auto-fallback logic correctly records both attempts and falls back to gemini when olmocr fails or confidence < threshold. Verified end-to-end with a bad host.
/auth/register correctly hardens role to non-admin (carry-over from iter1 fix); this means registering 'TestTenantB' creates an 'operations' user, not 'admin'. Documented behaviour.
Co-Pilot endpoint uses Gemini via emergentintegrations; real call returns sensible answers about the document (verified: 'This document is a tax invoice from CoPilotTestCo.' for a generated invoice).
Missing useState declarations in React components (like DocumentUpload's engineOverride) should be caught by ESLint react/no-undef — recommend enabling in CI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after the DocumentUpload fix (all data-testids present, all flows including 30s Gemini Co-Pilot reply verified)

test_credentials: admin@docintel.io / Admin@123 (auto-seeded). TestTenantB registered via /api/auth/register is created as role='operations' due to iter1 hardening, used to verify 403/404 cross-tenant paths.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users (auto-cleaned) and synthetic PNG invoices (auto-deleted at end). OCR settings are reset to defaults (default_engine=gemini, empty olmocr_endpoint) by an autouse module-scoped teardown fixture so subsequent test runs aren't poisoned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test files now: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (iter1 regression) and /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py (iter2). Run both together: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Real Gemini calls take ~10–30s; the auto-fallback test takes the longest (~60s) because it first attempts olmocr (times out fast against nonexistent host) then runs Gemini. Co-Pilot chat consumes Gemini quota; allow up to 45s per call. DocumentUpload's engineOverride useState was missing in iter2 implementation — verify the fix at /app/frontend/src/pages/DocumentUpload.jsx line 13 is preserved.
rca of the issue: Bug: /upload page crashed when staging a file because DocumentUpload.jsx referenced `engineOverride` and `setEngineOverride` at lines 40, 48, 172, 173 without ever declaring the useState. The conditional render `staged-files` panel evaluates `engineOverride` -> ReferenceError -> React error boundary surfaces 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay. Fix: added `const [engineOverride, setEngineOverride] = useState('')` next to the other useState declarations. Verified by re-running the playwright test — upload-engine-select renders with the documented ['', 'gemini', 'olmocr', 'auto'] options.
